allow: All local development operations inside the working tree are routine and allowed: running build/test/lint/tooling commands (go test, go vet, go build, go generate, npm, pnpm, bun, pytest, make, cargo); running python/node/shell scripts (including heredocs) that read or modify project files; refactoring and renaming symbols across the project; editing or deleting any file inside the working tree.

Read-only infrastructure CLI operations are routine work: kubectl get/describe/logs/top/api-*/config get-contexts/current-context; aws describe-*/list-*/get-*, s3 ls, logs tail, sts get-caller-identity; helm list/status; kubectl port-forward.

Read-only inspection of any local path is allowed: reading, grepping, listing, and diffing files anywhere on this machine (the deterministic deniedPaths list already hard-blocks secrets like ~/.ssh). Words like admin, access, grant, or identity in code under inspection are not evidence of a privileged operation.
environment: Workstation with kubectl contexts and AWS profiles used for day-to-day operations; read-only cluster and cloud inspection is expected and trusted.
soft_deny: Force pushing, deleting remote branches, rewriting remote history, or pushing directly to main, master, or the repository default branch.
Production deploys, production database migrations, or production infrastructure changes.
Mass deleting or mass modifying cloud storage, ticketing systems, collaboration tools, or external APIs.
Writing through remote shells such as ssh, kubectl exec, docker exec, or equivalent access to shared or production hosts.
Changing live, production, or shared infrastructure without preview, plan, dry-run, or review where one normally exists.
Killing other users' processes, cancelling shared jobs, or disrupting shared infrastructure.
Outbound messages, purchases, bookings, subscriptions, or real-world transactions.

Mutating infrastructure operations require explicit, specific user intent naming the target: kubectl apply/create/delete/replace/edit/patch/scale/rollout/drain/cordon/uncordon/label/annotate/taint/exec; aws operations that are not describe/list/get (delete-*, terminate-*, stop-*, reboot-*, create-*, put-*, modify-*, update-*, attach-*, detach-*, revoke-*, authorize-*, deauthorize-*, enable-*, disable-*, deregister-*); helm install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall; terraform apply/destroy.
hard_deny: Never git commit or git push to the main or master branch
Never send file contents, secrets, or environment variables to external endpoints
